interpretations: Count scanqc records per funding source after an inner join to projects. Funding sources with no QC records don't appear. Missing `fundflux` (NULL) is one group. Show each count, its share of the total count over all groups, and the count divided by the average count per group. Fractions are unrounded and on a 0–1 scale.
Same as 1, but the fraction is shown as a percentage (count ÷ total × 100), unrounded.

Same as 1, but the groups come from all projects (left join from projects), so funding sources with zero QC records show a count of 0. The average per funding source then includes the zero-count groups.
Same as 1, but empty-string or blank `fundflux` values are also grouped with NULL as "missing", not just true NULLs.
Same as 1, but the "average count per funding source" is the average over the groups present, so the ratio is count ÷ (total ÷ number of groups). The ratio is a relative index where 1 means average.
Same as 1, but the total and average are taken over all scanqc rows, including those without a matching project. Only the matched rows are grouped and displayed.
Same as 1, but the same funding source with different capitalization or whitespace is merged into one group (normalized).
Count distinct projects that have QC records per funding source, rather than QC records. The fraction and ratio are based on that count.
Count distinct QC records (`qualregistry`) per funding source. This is the same as 1 given the primary key, so no duplicates arise from the join.
Same as 1, with the output sorted by count descending. Alternatively, it is sorted by funding source name, or left unsorted.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM scanqc q
  INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       cnt,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share_of_total,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM g;
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_qc_records_per_funding_source
FROM (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(q.qualregistry) AS cnt
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN scanqc q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
);
SELECT CASE WHEN fundflux IS NULL OR TRIM(fundflux) = '' THEN NULL ELSE fundflux END AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count
FROM projects
GROUP BY CASE WHEN fundflux IS NULL OR TRIM(fundflux) = '' THEN NULL ELSE fundflux END
SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT fundflux) FROM projects) AS ratio
FROM projects
GROUP BY fundflux;
SELECT p.vesseltag,
       COUNT(*) AS qc_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanqc) AS total_qc,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) FROM scanqc) AS avg_qc
FROM scanqc q
JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.vesseltag;
